name: Tolterodine ER pivotal trial
question: In adults with overactive bladder and urge incontinence, how does once-daily tolterodine extended release compare with twice-daily immediate release and placebo?

design.population: 1,529 adults (81% women) with overactive-bladder symptoms for at least six months, at least eight micturitions per 24 hours, and five urge-incontinence episodes per week.
design.locator: Van Kerrebroeck 2001, PubMed abstract, Methods; Kelleher 2002, PDF p S609 (symptom duration and centers); FDA medical review of protocol 98-TOCR-007, p 13 (phase)

verdictNote: Both formulations beat placebo; ER had less dry mouth than IR.
takeaway: In a 12-week randomized trial, tolterodine ER 4 mg daily and tolterodine IR 2 mg twice daily each reduced urge-incontinence episodes versus placebo; ER produced a larger reported reduction and less dry mouth than IR.

reports.label: Randomized 12-week report
reports.dateLocator: PubMed 11248608, March 2001 issue; Crossref published date-parts [2001,3]
reports.citation: Van Kerrebroeck P, Kreder K, Jonas U, et al. "Tolterodine once-daily: superior efficacy and tolerability in the treatment of the overactive bladder." *Urology.* 2001;57(3):414-421. doi:10.1016/s0090-4295(00)01113-4

results.measure: Change in mean weekly episodes at 12 weeks
results.note: ER versus placebo P = 0.0001; IR versus placebo P = 0.0005. ER versus IR was reported as 18% more effective (P < 0.05). Absolute mean changes and confidence intervals are absent from the abstract.

results.measure: Median percentage reduction from baseline at 12 weeks
results.note: The reported significance tests concern mean changes, not these medians.

results.measure: Frequency, pad use, and volume voided per micturition at 12 weeks
results.note: Mean frequency decreased (P < 0.0079) and pad use decreased (P < 0.0145) for both formulations; mean voided volume increased (P = 0.0001). Absolute changes are absent from the abstract.

harms.label: Dry mouth, any severity
harms.note: ER dry-mouth rate was reported as 23% lower than IR (P < 0.02); event numerators and safety denominators are not given in the abstract.

harms.label: Severe dry mouth
harms.note: Comparator rates and event numerators are not given in the abstract.

harms.label: Treatment withdrawal
harms.note: The abstract gives no withdrawal counts or percentages.

delivery.label: Diary run-in
delivery.value: One- to two-week washout/run-in to confirm micturition-diary eligibility.

values.er: oral ER capsule 4 mg once daily for 12 weeks
values.ir: oral IR tablet 2 mg twice daily for 12 weeks

reports.label: 12-month open-label extension
reports.dateLocator: PubMed 12074774, June 2002 issue; Crossref published date-parts [2002,6]
reports.citation: Kreder K, Mayne C, Jonas U. "Long-term safety, tolerability and efficacy of extended-release tolterodine in the treatment of overactive bladder." *Eur Urol.* 2002;41(6):588-595. doi:10.1016/s0302-2838(02)00177-x
reports.followUp: 12 months of open-label ER treatment after the randomized phase

results.measure: Median percentage change from baseline among 759 extension completers at 12 months
results.note: All extension participants received ER, regardless of prior randomized assignment.

results.measure: Median percentage change from baseline among 759 extension completers at 12 months

harms.label: Dry mouth during extension
harms.note: The abstract gives the rate without an event count or safety denominator.

delivery.label: Extension entry and completion
delivery.value: Of 1,377 randomized-phase completers, 1,077 (78% as reported) entered 12 months of open-label ER; 71% of extension entrants completed it.

reports.label: 12-week quality-of-life analysis
reports.citation: Kelleher CJ, Reese PR, Pleil AM, et al. "Health-related quality of life of patients receiving extended-release tolterodine for overactive bladder." *Am J Manag Care.* 2002;8(19 Suppl):S608-S615. PMID:12516955
reports.followUp: 12 weeks of randomized treatment; ER and placebo arms only

results.measure: Mean score change at 12 weeks; adjusted between-group mean difference
results.note: Prespecified primary HRQoL domain in this secondary report; lower score is better. Effect is adjusted ER minus placebo, not the subtraction of displayed unadjusted changes.
results.locator: PDF p S611, Table 1 and Methods p S610

results.measure: Mean score change at 12 weeks; adjusted between-group mean difference
results.note: Prespecified primary HRQoL domain in this secondary report; lower score is better. Effect is adjusted ER minus placebo.
results.locator: PDF p S611, Table 1 and Methods p S610

results.endpoint: SF-36 physical and mental summary scores
results.locator: PDF p S613, Table 2 and Results
